subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): surface accountId on agent hook context

question: Should OpenClaw publish `ctx.accountId` as the canonical plugin hook context field, and should the exported helper accept `agentAccountId` as a public compatibility alias?
rationale: This changes public plugin SDK surface and the remaining blocker is API contract intent, not a source-level uncertainty automation can safely choose.

options.title: Approve accountId, remove alias
options.body: Treat `ctx.accountId` as canonical and require the branch to map internal `agentAccountId` values to `accountId` before calling the exported helper.

options.title: Approve both names
options.body: Document `agentAccountId` as an intentional helper input with precedence and a deprecation or support plan before merge.

options.title: Pause for naming direction
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a stable public account identity contract for plugin hooks.

recommendation.title: Approve accountId, remove alias
recommendation.body: Treat `ctx.accountId` as canonical and require the branch to map internal `agentAccountId` values to `accountId` before calling the exported helper.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent SDK-boundary and hooks ownership signal among the relevant history candidates.
